content: Root cause: The bug was caused by storing the IRQ value in an unsigned integer, which could lead to the loss of error information returned by the `platform_get_irq_byname()` function. This function can return negative error codes, which would be discarded when assigned to an unsigned integer, resulting in incorrect handling of IRQ registration failures. The fix involved changing the type of the IRQ variable from unsigned int to int to properly capture and handle error values.
